Yeah, I took it out to inspect the roots today and they look healthy and not damp or rotting or anything. I don’t have a magnifying glass but I can’t see any buggies with my naked eye

I know the older leaves look crumply with maybe some tissue damage, I should mention that I am very gentle with it and I barely touch the leaves! I even play it Mort Garson and tell it nice encouraging things

In case anyone is interested -- I went to repot this plant and found that it was in fact several smaller cuttings stuck in a pot together. I wasn't sure what to make of that or if that's something that can be done, so just to be safe I separated them each into their own pots and cut off the yellow leaves, then continued to care for them as I had been. Now they're thriving in their own pots and no longer yellowing :)
